title: nntrainer GPU baseline measurement v1
description: Schema for the JSON emitted by tools/gpu_bench/run_baseline.sh after running the OpenCL unittests with the M0-1 per-kernel profiler enabled (-Denable-profile=true). One record per (binary, kernel) pair aggregating all enqueue calls of that kernel within the run. Comparisons against ML Drift (arXiv:2505.00232) parity targets use exec_total_us / avg_us as the primary metrics.

schema_version.description: Bump on any change to required fields or semantics.

kernel.description: OpenCL kernel name as passed to clCreateKernel. May contain spaces if the build appends a variant suffix.

calls.description: Number of clEnqueueNDRangeKernel invocations aggregated into this record.

exec_total_us.description: Sum of (END - START) timestamps in microseconds. Primary metric for ROI comparison.

avg_us.description: exec_total_us / calls, microseconds. Two decimal digits as emitted by the profiler.

max_us.description: Maximum single-call execution time. A wide max/min spread can flag warmup / dispatch-stall issues.

queued_us.description: Sum of (SUBMIT - QUEUED) — time spent waiting in host queue before driver submit. High values indicate host-side scheduling overhead.

submit_us.description: Sum of (START - SUBMIT) — driver-side submission latency. High values can indicate driver compile / param-setup overhead.

pct_exec.description: Share of this kernel's exec_total_us within the run's grand total. Drives prioritization of optimization targets.
